address: 60 Western Road, Brighton and Hove, BN3 1JD, United Kingdom
bio: Cin Cin’s loyal band of customers come for its great value Italian food, where fresh ingredients are simply cooked and natural flavours are allowed to shine. You can create a different experience every time you visit by sitting in a different place: in front of the open kitchen, at the horseshoe counter, gazing out the window onto the street or in the calmer rear room. Wherever you choose, the terrific homemade pasta is a must – look out for the daily special on the blackboard. An all-Italian wine list completes the picture....
